answer: When an AI joins the PoA economy it must lock a jade‑token of 10 PoA on the network’s jetty node and then execute a sparrow‑protocol random walk of length ℓ, collecting the identifiers of every agent visited. The walk is accepted only if the cut‑conductance of the subgraph induced by the collected identifiers exceeds a threshold τ, which genuine agents normally satisfy but a Sybil cluster behind a narrow cut fails.
